checks.name: anonymous users can read the hosted doctor catalog
anonymous booking is denied
five synthetic Auth accounts log in with real passwords; role metadata grants no privileges
an incorrect password is rejected
patients may only read their own hosted profile
patients cannot grant themselves an admin role
hosted RPC rejects invalid patient fields independently
hosted bookings preserve Vietnamese names and patient details
50 concurrent hosted booking requests create exactly one appointment and 49 conflicts
availability marks the occupied hosted slot
another patient cannot read the booking
another patient cannot cancel the booking
an unrelated doctor cannot read the booking
a fresh independent login retrieves the persisted appointment
the hosted Realtime subscription connects
the owner can cancel the booking
Realtime delivers the authorized appointment update
cancelling releases the slot for another patient
reception cannot check in tomorrow appointments today
patients cannot perform staff check-in
reception can check in the same-day time fixture by its real booking code
reception cannot write a medical record
an unrelated doctor cannot write a medical record
the assigned doctor saves the medical record and completes the appointment
the appointment owner reads the persisted medical record
another patient cannot read the medical record
reception cannot read the private medical record
completed appointments cannot be cancelled

limitations: 50-request contention check; not a sustained k6 100-VU benchmark.
Same-day check-in used a controlled SQL time fixture.
No camera, browser UI or device acceptance covered by this script.
